title: Cinque Terre Content Calendar Configuration
description: A few topics of the real site's calendar, in its shape (the eval harness takes its briefs from the unpublished ones). The Portovenere topic is published already.

topics.title: How to Beat the Summer Crowds
topics.brief: Practical strategies for enjoying Cinque Terre in peak summer. Cover the best times of day to visit each village, the trains to avoid, quieter trails, and how staying overnight in Vernazza or Manarola changes the experience.

topics.title: The Grape Harvest in Manarola
topics.brief: The vendemmia on the terraces above Manarola: when it happens, how the monorails work, the Sciacchetrà tradition, and how visitors can watch or join without getting in the way.

topics.title: Day Trip to Portovenere
topics.brief: Published already: the eval harness must skip it.

topics.title: Where Locals Eat in Winter
topics.brief: Which restaurants in Riomaggiore and Monterosso stay open in winter, what is on the menu in the cold months, and how to book when half the village is closed.

evergreen_content.description: Content that remains relevant year-round, updated annually

topics.title: Complete Train Schedule Guide
topics.brief: Train travel between the five villages: the regional line, how often trains run, the Cinque Terre Card, La Spezia connections and platform tips.
